data.one_liner: A Flutter UI kit providing one-to-one and group chat screens, messaging widgets, and APIs.
data.what_it_does: ZIMKit provides a low-code UI wrapper for chat applications, offering ready-to-use conversation lists, one-to-one and group chat screens, and messaging APIs. It supports text, image, voice, video, and file messages along with message actions like replies, reactions, and forwarding.
use_when: You need to quickly integrate one-to-one and group chat interfaces into a Flutter application.
You want built-in UI components for conversation lists, message histories, and group management.
avoid_when: You require a completely custom chat UI built from scratch without pre-packaged widgets.
You are using a backend messaging service other than ZIM.
strengths: Provides ready-to-use conversation and message screens out of the box.
Supports rich messaging types including text, image, voice, video, and files.
Includes built-in group details and member management pages.
weaknesses: Tied closely to the ZIM backend and signaling ecosystem.
Customizing deeply beyond the provided configuration options can be constrained by the low-code design.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the SDK with your app ID and app sign, then connect a user before showing the chat UI.
